records.title: Shortage of Manpower in Aviation Regulatory Bodies
details: a to e: The total number of sanctioned posts in BCAS is 598, out of which 230 posts are vacant. Keeping in view of effective supervision, additional 84 posts have been created in 2024.

records.title: QUANTITY OF TAP WATER TO RURAL HOUSEHOLD UNDER JJM
details: a to d: Further the extension of JJM is being considered by the government after which appropriate timeline will be worked out.
